display.name: AI providers
display.description: Request counts and response times per AI provider and model. See docs/MONITORING.md.

display.name: Requests per interval by model
display.description: All calls in each time bucket, including failed ones and calls stopped before they reached the provider. Bars are stacked by model, so a bar's height is the total. Bucket width follows the time range the same way SigNoz picks the step for query-builder panels: about 300 buckets, at least 1 minute, in steps of 5 minutes from 1 day and 30 minutes from 7 days. The legend shows the width. The first and last bars can cover part of a bucket.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT ts, model_name, interval, sum(delta) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    fingerprint,
    intDiv($end_timestamp_ms - $start_timestamp_ms, 1000) AS range_seconds,
    intDiv(range_seconds, 300) AS raw_step,
    raw_step - raw_step % 60 AS minute_step,
    multiIf(raw_step < 60, 60, range_seconds >= 604800, intDiv(minute_step + 900, 1800) * 1800, range_seconds >= 86400, intDiv(minute_step + 150, 300) * 300, minute_step) AS bucket_seconds,
    multiIf(bucket_seconds % 3600 = 0, concat(toString(intDiv(bucket_seconds, 3600)), 'h'), bucket_seconds > 3600, concat(toString(intDiv(bucket_seconds, 3600)), 'h ', toString(intDiv(bucket_seconds % 3600, 60)), 'm'), concat(toString(intDiv(bucket_seconds, 60)), 'm')) AS interval,
    toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), toIntervalSecond(bucket_seconds)) AS ts,
    if(value >= previous, value - previous, value) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT
      fingerprint,
      unix_milli,
      value,
      lagInFrame(value, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS previous
    FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.requests.count'
      AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 3600000
      AND unix_milli <= $end_timestamp_ms
      AND bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0
  )
  WHERE unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms
) AS points
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fingerprint,
    JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name') AS model_name
  FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4
  WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.requests.count'
    AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 7200000
    AND (has(arrayFlatten([$host]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$host]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name')))
    AND (has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider')))
    AND (has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name')))
) AS series USING fingerprint
GROUP BY ts, model_name, interval
ORDER BY ts

display.name: Streaming: time until the response starts
display.description: How long the provider took to send response headers on streamed calls. The answer keeps arriving after this.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT ts, provider, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(le, delta) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT ts, provider, le, sum(delta) AS delta
  FROM (
  SELECT ts, provider, le, outcome, sum(delta) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT
      fingerprint,
      toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv($end_timestamp_ms - $start_timestamp_ms, 200000)))) AS ts,
      if(value >= previous, value - previous, value) AS delta
    FROM (
      SELECT
        fingerprint,
        unix_milli,
        value,
        lagInFrame(value, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS previous
      FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
      WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.response_start.duration.bucket'
        AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 3600000
        AND unix_milli <= $end_timestamp_ms
        AND bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0
    )
    WHERE unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms
  ) AS points
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fingerprint,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'outcome') AS outcome,
      if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'le') = '+Inf', inf, toFloat64(JSONExtractString(labels, 'le'))) AS le
    FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.response_start.duration.bucket'
      AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 7200000
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$host]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$host]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name')))
      AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'streaming') = 'true'
  ) AS series USING fingerprint
  GROUP BY ts, provider, le, outcome
  )
  GROUP BY ts, provider, le
)
GROUP BY ts, provider
HAVING isFinite(value)
ORDER BY ts

display.name: Failed calls per minute by outcome
display.description: ok is excluded. A hung provider mostly appears as cancelled, because the outer timeout fires first. Read timeout and cancelled together.

filter.expression: host.name IN $host AND provider IN $provider AND model_name IN $model_name AND outcome != 'ok'

display.name: Stream endings per minute by outcome
display.description: ok only means headers arrived. A stream can still fail or be cancelled afterwards.

filter.expression: host.name IN $host AND provider IN $provider AND model_name IN $model_name

display.name: Summary by provider and model
display.description: All calls in the selected time range, including failed ones and calls stopped before they reached the provider. Percentiles use ok calls only.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  counts.provider AS provider,
  counts.model_name AS model_name,
  counts.requests AS requests,
  round(100 * counts.failed / counts.requests, 1) AS failed_percent,
  latency.p50_seconds AS p50_seconds,
  latency.p95_seconds AS p95_seconds
FROM (
  SELECT provider, model_name, sum(delta) AS requests, sumIf(delta, outcome != 'ok') AS failed
  FROM (
  SELECT provider, model_name, outcome, sum(delta) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT fingerprint, if(value >= previous, value - previous, value) AS delta
    FROM (
      SELECT
        fingerprint,
        unix_milli,
        value,
        lagInFrame(value, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS previous
      FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
      WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.requests.count'
        AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 3600000
        AND unix_milli <= $end_timestamp_ms
        AND bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0
    )
    WHERE unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms
  ) AS points
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fingerprint,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name') AS model_name,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'outcome') AS outcome
    FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.requests.count'
      AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 7200000
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$host]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$host]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name')))
  ) AS series USING fingerprint
  GROUP BY provider, model_name, outcome
  )
  GROUP BY provider, model_name
  HAVING requests > 0
) AS counts
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    provider,
    model_name,
    quantilePrometheusHistogramIf(0.5)(le, delta, outcome = 'ok') AS p50,
    if(isNaN(p50), NULL, round(p50, 2)) AS p50_seconds,
    quantilePrometheusHistogramIf(0.95)(le, delta, outcome = 'ok') AS p95,
    if(isNaN(p95), NULL, round(p95, 2)) AS p95_seconds
  FROM (
    SELECT provider, model_name, le, outcome, sum(delta) AS delta
    FROM (
    SELECT ts, provider, model_name, le, outcome, sum(delta) AS delta
  FROM (
    SELECT
      fingerprint,
      toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(unix_milli, 1000)), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv($end_timestamp_ms - $start_timestamp_ms, 200000)))) AS ts,
      if(value >= previous, value - previous, value) AS delta
    FROM (
      SELECT
        fingerprint,
        unix_milli,
        value,
        lagInFrame(value, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS previous
      FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4
      WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.response_start.duration.bucket'
        AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 3600000
        AND unix_milli <= $end_timestamp_ms
        AND bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0
    )
    WHERE unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms
  ) AS points
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      fingerprint,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name') AS model_name,
      JSONExtractString(labels, 'outcome') AS outcome,
      if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'le') = '+Inf', inf, toFloat64(JSONExtractString(labels, 'le'))) AS le
    FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'echo.ai_provider.response_start.duration.bucket'
      AND unix_milli >= $start_timestamp_ms - 7200000
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$host]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$host]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$provider]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider')))
      AND (has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), '__all__') OR has(arrayFlatten([$model_name]), JSONExtractString(labels, 'model_name')))
  ) AS series USING fingerprint
  GROUP BY ts, provider, model_name, le, outcome
    )
    GROUP BY provider, model_name, le, outcome
  )
  GROUP BY provider, model_name
) AS latency ON counts.provider = latency.provider AND counts.model_name = latency.model_name
ORDER BY requests DESC
